resources.string: Your paired phone can read health records in the background, over Bluetooth only. You don\'t need to open this page day to day. Finding your watch works either way. This app doesn\'t sign in or connect to any vendor cloud.

Also reads workouts, GPS routes and per-point detail. Allow the Magisk prompt when turning this on. A temporary database snapshot is made in this app\'s private folder and deleted after reading. Stock workout records aren\'t changed. Regular health reading is unaffected when this is off.

Saved to Download/TicBox, never uploaded. The file contains health values, record IDs and times. Full workout points also contain GPS locations and are off by default, so check route privacy before sharing. Turn on root sources on the previous page first.
Use sleep and oxygen sample preset
Enter a date, a date and time, or epoch milliseconds, such as 2026-11-03 or 2026-11-03 08:30. Times use the watch\'s time zone. An end date includes that whole day.

Rows are read in source cursor order, so they aren\'t necessarily the newest. Cancelling, row limits and refused queries are recorded in the file\'s status. You can turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth first and fetch the file over USB only.
Choose at least one source, and check the type IDs, dates and row count. Dates look like 2026-11-03 and times like 2026-11-03 08:30. The start can\'t be after the end.
Exporting… Cancel keeps what has been read.
